name: Glimpse of Knowledge
body:
School divination; Level bard 3, sorcerer/wizard 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 minute
Components V

EFFECT

Range personal
Duration instantaneous

DESCRIPTION

You make a caster level check in place of an untrained or failed Knowledge check; you are considered trained in this skill for the purpose of this check. If you are not a bard you suffer 2 points of Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma damage as your untrained mind attempts to deal with the overload of information.
